messages:
deploy-bot: starting feature flag rollout 'dynamic-reroute' for `request-gateway` in eu-central-1. plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 20m windows. note: runtime pinned to v2.4.0 for canaries. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dynamic-reroute

emily: kicking off 1% now. quiet window allowed 02:00-05:00 CET. i'll watch errors and request latency for the next 10m.

raj: checklist posted: p50/p95, 5xx, client-side timeouts, token cost delta, cache miss rate. alerts set to paging at 0.75% 5xx.

tonys: executing via safebot:```
/safebot ff set dynamic-reroute --env prod --pct 1 --metadata "canary emily"
```

ops-bot: infra check ok, no pod restarts. prometheus snapshot: https://obs.internal/snap/def456

emily: 1% traffic routed. p95 +120ms vs baseline, p50 unchanged. 5xx at 0.04% (baseline 0.03%). small invoice to monitoring but within gate.

raj: small cache miss increase, looks like header normalization difference. digging.

oncall-note: customer pins: three enterprise customers pinned to old route; ensure they remain pinned.

deploy-bot: auto-advance scheduled to 5% at +12m if no regression.

emily: i'm going to hold on auto-advance, want full kv-store heatmap for 15m. pausing.

tonys: safebot: auto-advance paused by emily. next action required: `/safebot ff approve dynamic-reroute --next 5` to continue or `/safebot ff rollback dynamic-reroute` to revert.

ops-bot: telemetry update t+9m: p95 still +110ms, 5xx ticked to 0.12% (drift). not alarming. cache miss steady.

emily: decision: we keep paused and annotate release notes with header-change detail. i'll request a quick patch to preserve header behavior before continuing.

raj: agreed. i'm opening PR with normalization toggle and marking as hotfix. if merge before next window we can resume ramp.

kate: tagging support to notify the pinned customers about the maintenance window and that their cohorts are pinned until we explicitly unpin. message template: "We're rolling a routing update to improve parity; we'll keep your traffic pinned to the current runtime during the soak window."

emily: thanks folks. no rollback for now. manual resume planned after hotfix and a 10m soak post-merge. will update thread when ready. :eyes:
